meta.name: atxp
meta.description: Access ATXP paid API tools for web search, AI image generation, music creation, video generation, and X/Twitter search. Use when users need real-time web search, AI-generated media (images, music, video), or X/Twitter search. Requires authentication via `npx atxp login`.

copy.tagline_en: Access paid APIs for web search, media generation, and social search

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以调用 ATXP 付费 API 进行实时网络搜索、生成 AI 图片、音乐、视频，以及搜索 X/Twitter 内容。
